title: Stock Market News Collector output
description: Primary output is the default dataset (one JSON object per news article). Secondary output is the OUTPUT key in the key-value store with runStatus, feedStats, and failures. The Actor exits successfully unless failOnAllFeedsFailed is set; agents must read runStatus to detect empty, partial, or no-new-article runs.

articles.title: News articles
articles.description: Array of normalized stock market news articles. Each item has headline, source, publishedDate, articleLink, summary, tickers, dedupeKey, and (when enabled) companyDetails, eventTypes, sentimentScore, sentimentLabel, and fullText. Use this as the primary output for RAG, alerts, and dashboards.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: JSON object at key OUTPUT. Contains runStatus (ok|partial|no_items|no_new_items|all_feeds_failed|error), count, skippedAlreadySeen, spendingLimitReached, feedStats, failures, and warnings. Always check runStatus when count is 0.
